metadata.title: Massive Langar @ Manikaran Gurudwara and Ram Temple + Hot Springs + Pure Himachali Dham + Siddu dish
metadata.description:
After soaking in the mountain calm of Kasol, we set out the next morning for Manikaran with our gracious host Khusboo, a traveller and entrepreneur who runs a warm and welcoming homestay in Himachal. We had stayed the night at The Hosteller, a perfect pitstop for backpackers, offering a clean and comfy stay with all the right amenities. Their set breakfast the next morning, with its hearty spread, was just what we needed to start the day.
Manikaran is a short drive from Kasol and holds deep religious significance for both Sikhs and Hindus. The two main sites here are the Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara and the Ram Mandir, standing side by side amidst the rising steam of natural hot springs. These springs are believed to have healing properties. People bathe in the warm waters, and part of the langar is cooked in large pots using the geothermal energy. After speaking to people at both the langar and the Ram Mandir kitchen, we sat for a meal at the Gurudwara, a simple, soulful thali served with love in the spirit of seva.
Just outside, we picked up some sweets before heading towards our next stop, the Himalayan Village. This serene resort is perched between pine trees beside the Parvati River, offering a peaceful retreat in nature. Lunch at their restaurant, Kailasha, featured a traditional Kangri Dham, a slow-cooked, multi-course meal with five to six dishes served on a thali. Dham is a festive Himachali meal, deeply rooted in temple and community celebrations, full of unique flavours and local ingredients.
We stayed the night at the property. For dinner, we tried Siddu, a Himachali bread stuffed with a savoury poppy seed and walnut filling. Rich, warm, and comforting. Later, we met the owner and heard the story behind this stunning property that brings together heritage, craftsmanship, and mountain comfort.
Check out the full video to discover the soulful food, stories, and serene places that made this day unforgettable.
